_meta: EN 只写主体：人物、动作、场景、道具、光线。画风一律由 style_suffix + negative_clause 决定，EN 里不得出现 cartoon/anime/ink-wash/水墨/插画/flat/infographic/photorealistic/3d render/chiaroscuro/silk-scroll 等风格词，也不得要求画面渲染文字（negative_clause 含 no text）。

XL01.en: A young Tang crown prince pushing open a heavy wooden gate into a poor walled courtyard, two thin figures visible beyond, autumn leaves blowing

XL02.en: Two emaciated women in coarse hemp skirts pounding grain in a bleak walled courtyard, a young prince standing still at the gate watching them

XL03.en: A Tang prince with red eyes handing a memorial scroll to a eunuch outside a palace hall, torchlight, his hands trembling

XL04.en: A Tang empress in dark phoenix robes turning sharply in a lamplit corridor, cold furious eyes, memorial scrolls scattered at her feet

XL05.en: Tang soldiers fleeing across a bleak windswept highland battlefield, snow and dust blinding, fallen banners half-buried

XL06.en: A young crown prince in plain robes reviewing grain registers with grey-bearded officials inside the Eastern Palace, daylight through lattice windows

XL07.en: A half-blind middle-aged Tang emperor groping over memorials he cannot read, one hand trailing across the desk, a single candle burning low

XL08.en: An old chancellor kneeling to block an edict in a grand audience hall, forehead nearly touching the floor tiles, the emperor seated above, torchlight

XL09.en: An imperial procession leaving Chang'an for Luoyang under low leaden rain clouds, carriage curtains closed, wet road glistening

XL10.en: A palace bedchamber at night in Luoyang, physicians kneeling around a still bed, candles guttering, rain streaking the windows

XL11.en: A celadon bowl of dark medicine steaming on a low palace table, an overturned cup beside it, a single lamp flame leaning

XL12.en: Tang officials and armored guards exchanging fearful glances beneath palace eaves in rain, no one speaking

XL13.en: A young prince alone in a vast empty palace corridor at night, a towering shadowed wall ahead, one distant lamp

XL14.en: An old half-blind emperor weeping over an empty crown prince's robes laid on a bier, white mourning drapes hanging, candles all around

XL15.en: A grand imperial tomb mound rising on the plain at dusk, a white-bannered funeral procession winding toward it, low red sun

XL16.en: A sharp-eyed young prince in dark ceremonial robes ascending the Eastern Palace steps, cold morning light, officials watching from below

XL17.en: A pearl curtain hanging in a dark palace hall, a pair of watching eyes faintly visible behind the beads, a single lamp burning
